original.quote: The Buyer shall pay each invoice within fifteen (15) days of the invoice date (Net 15).

redline.proposed_text: The Buyer shall pay all undisputed invoices within thirty (30) days of the date of a valid invoice.
redline.rationale: Replaced Net 15 with Net 30 to comply with PAYMENT-001 fallback.

original.quote: The Supplier does not commit to any specific uptime percentage, and no service credits are payable for unavailability.

redline.proposed_text: The Supplier shall meet a measurable service level of at least 99.9% platform availability per calendar month, with service credits of 5% of the monthly fee per percentage point missed, capped at 20% of the monthly fee.
redline.rationale: Replaced missing uptime commitment with measurable uptime and credits per SLA-001 fallback.
